data_statistics: 200 eligible patients; 142 ICU survivors (final cohort) with median age 56 years (IQR 47-65), 16% female, 52% obese
results: VATI and SATI significantly correlated with ICU LOS and ventilation duration (ρ=0.25-0.27, p=0.003-0.001 and ρ=0.19-0.24, p=0.024-0.003); AATI remained significant while BMI did not (+15.5% per SD for ICU LOS, +30.8% per SD for ventilation duration, p=0.016 and p<0.001 respectively); BMI not significantly correlated

title: Advancing trauma scoring through large language models: automated estimation of injury severity.
data_statistics: Validation cohort with ISS scores ranging 1–41 (median 9, IQR 12; mean 11.71±8.64)
results: Weighted Kappa: Grok-3 0.91, GPT-4 0.88, Perplexity 0.54; ICCs: 0.97 (GPT-4), 0.92 (Grok-3), 0.84 (Perplexity); mean biases small positive; LoA ±5.2 (GPT-4), ±7.0 (Grok-3), ±9.7 (Perplexity); performance decreased for severe injuries (ISS ≥16)
